text: In 1855, something reportedly walked over houses and left only hoofprints.
One February night, after heavy snow.
By morning, hoof-like prints ran through the snow, mostly in single file.
the trail went straight over houses, walls and haystacks.
Even in and out of drainpipes.
In total: an estimated 40 to 100 miles of tracks.
Some people said they were the tracks of Satan himself.
Others blamed badgers, wood mice, escaped kangaroos...
But none of it has ever been confirmed.
And some reports have been questioned.
Over 170 years later, nobody knows what made the Devil's Footprints.
